description: Make a public link to an artifact that anyone with the address can open without signing in (review notes, costs and hidden parts never show). `version` pins it (else it follows the latest), `scope` view_history also shows past versions, `expires_at` (ISO with offset) ends it. You confirm in a dialog; unshare_artifact revokes it. The result has `share_url` (the public page) and `app_url` (its page in the web app).
name: share_artifact
title: Share an artifact
